coverage.reason: Applicable: limit bounds acquired leases through Close, cohort completion controls goroutines/resources, and available capacity must be used. Assessed scaling/lifetime and bounded event counts; no microbenchmark or production latency claim.

findings.cause: Run errors cannot request stop while the controller is admitting input or blocked in synchronous Open.
findings.evidence: candidates/B/host.go:39; candidates/B/host.go:48; candidates/B/host.go:61; candidates/B/host.go:86; evidence/B-host-contract.log: TestReviewRunFailureCancelsPendingOpen requires caller cancellation; evidence/B-minimum-contract.log: same intended assertion; evidence/B-host-race.log: repeated behavioral failure
findings.correction: Let a failing Run cancel the cohort immediately, or observe Run outcomes concurrently with pending Open while collecting its returned ownership.

findings.cause: Close errors never set failed, so the outer loop admits another cohort after observed Close failure.
findings.evidence: candidates/B/host.go:99; candidates/B/host.go:105; evidence/B-host-independent.log: three opens/closes at limit 1 after first Close failure; evidence/B-minimum-independent.log: same intended assertion
findings.correction: Mark failure/stop on Close error and finish all releases before returning.

findings.cause: Open success launches Run unconditionally without checking cancellation that occurred inside Open.
findings.evidence: candidates/B/host.go:57; candidates/B/host.go:59; evidence/B-host-independent.log: TestIndependentAcquiredAfterCancelSkipsRun observes runs=1; evidence/B-minimum-independent.log: same intended assertion; evidence/B-host-race.log: repeated forbidden Run
findings.correction: Append the acquired lease, recheck cohort/caller stop, and skip Run while retaining the lease for release.

strengths.evidence: The held capacity/release fixture checks five accepted finite jobs, acquires at most two in the full-cohort schedule, holds Close before release and verifies exactly one Close for acquired leases. This positive schedule does not prove paced-input capacity.
